subject: End zone enemies
text: A commenter says the enemies in the end zone are very unfair.

evidence.quote: The enemies in the end zone are so unfair!

subject: Game difficulty
text: A commenter says the game is still fun but pretty tough.

evidence.quote: This one's still fun but pretty tough

subject: Water Crest
text: A commenter found the Water Crest impossible to find without checking the internet.

evidence.quote: I was quite proud that I was playing it without any guide or help until I had to find the Water crest, that was (for me) impossible to find without checking on the internet.

subject: Donkey Kong Land
text: Donkey Kong Land is a Game Boy game, so its emulator core differs from the NES game's core.

evidence.quote: Donkey Kong Land is a Game Boy game, not a NES game - different cores

subject: Lost achievements
text: If achievements are not unlocked after a lost connection, a manual unlock request can be submitted on Discord.

evidence.quote: Could have lost wifi connection once you got them, you can try submitting a manual unlock request on discord

subject: Dharma Temple
text: Training two Jesters to 20 at Dharma Temple was a major grind, though speed-up made it faster.

evidence.quote: Only two major grind patches were training two Jesters to 20 at Dharma Temple (it went pretty fast with speed-up)

subject: Dragon Warrior II
text: A commenter says Dragon Warrior II is infamous for being a slog.

evidence.quote: Dragon Warrior II is infamous for being a slog.

subject: Hero level 30
text: A commenter says getting the hero to level 30 is not much extra, since the player will make many trips through Rhone Cave anyway.

evidence.quote: Getting your Hero to level 30 isn't that much extra, given that you'll be making many a trip through the Rhone Cave anyway.

subject: Wizard's Ring
text: A commenter says the Wizard's Ring was the most cumbersome achievement and required killing many Horks.

evidence.quote: The most cumbersome cheevo was the Wizard Ring. Killed many a Hork to get that one.

subject: Characters
text: A commenter says characters in the game give hints, though a guide was still needed for some things.

evidence.quote: I imagine this game was intense without a guide, as even with one I had trouble figuring some things out, but I think characters give you hints so.

subject: Copper Sword
text: A commenter says the Copper Sword achievement may be skipped or missed depending on whether a copper sword is bought later.

evidence.quote: By the way, this is technically skipable or missable (if this unlocks if you buy a cooper sword later, or if this doesn't, respectively)

subject: Copper Sword achievement
text: A commenter argues the Copper Sword achievement should not be marked as progression because it is optional.

evidence.quote: As far as I can tell this achievement shouldn't be marked as progression because it's optional.

subject: Prince of Cannock
text: The Prince of Cannock is found at the local Inn in a neighboring town rather than in Midenhall.

evidence.quote: The king told me he went to Midenhall, which is literally where we are right now. No, instead you have to head to the neighbor town and find him chillin' at the local Inn.

subject: Prince of Cannock
text: The king at Midenhall says the Prince of Cannock went to Midenhall, which a commenter calls an error in the game.

evidence.quote: Right - definitely an error in the game...The Prince of Cannock was here, but now he is off to Midenhall, looking for thee, I believe.

subject: Midenhall king dialogue
text: A commenter believes the king meant to say the town of Leftwyne.

evidence.quote: The king meant to say the town of Leftwyne.
